_comment: Authoritative choreography for IMG_3775.mov, in VIDEO SECONDS, built from
frame-annotated review (the top-left clock). Every jump and dodge below is
predetermined: it happens at exactly `time` on every playthrough. Player
input only scores - a press inside the window clears, otherwise the ball
flashes red and the motion happens anyway. type `hop` is a small automatic
believability hop (a level change, a kerb) that is never cued or scored.
`time` is the takeoff; `airTime` is takeoff-to-landing; `height` is the arc
peak in frame heights. Takeoffs and air times are sized against the frames
themselves: the rule is that no frame of an arc may show the ball
overlapping the obstacle it clears - which is why several takeoffs sit
earlier than the obstacle reaching the ball (the van's hood arrives at the
column before the annotated moment) and several arcs outlast the
obstacle's whole crossing (the parked car crosses the old landing spot).
Scoring windows and warning leads are derived from the gaps between scored
events at authoring time; hops are invisible to that derivation.

surfaces._why: the suv jump is annotated 'landing on the sidewalk at 18.62' - with the handover at 19.39 the ball landed on the floor line and rolled the lot's curb for 0.8s before the sidewalk took over. Handing over just before touchdown makes the landing spot and the roll-out the sidewalk plane itself
bush 1's pixels are under the ball's column from ~26.2 (was 26.6, tuned to the old past-the-sign landing); the 25.75 arc lands on the hedge line at 26.25

events.label: car
events._why: gravity-exact (T = 2.44*sqrt(h)); the old 6.41/2.2s arc hung at its apex 64% longer than gravity allows. The ball rolls the rail while the car passes beneath its line, vaults as it crosses (7.3-8.5), and lands at 8.55 right behind it - the same arc still carries the rail-to-road drop

events.label: van (whole)
events._why: the van's hood reaches the column at ~9.7, before the annotated 9.94 - takeoff must beat it; landing 11.55 right after the tail is annotated exact

events.label: suv
events._why: annotated landing on the sidewalk at 18.62. Height 0.48 (was 0.44): the drawn 0.44 was calibrated when lift rode the live line, which rises 0.05 toward the walkway mid-arc - the accepted look. The parabola measures height above the take-off line, so 0.48 restores the same apex over the suv; gravity still holds (2.44*sqrt(0.48) = 1.69 >= 1.62)

events.label: people
events._why: natural gravity: a ~2.4m leap takes ~1.7-1.9s, and 2.6s read as moon-float; takeoff 23.2 still beats the first woman, peak still centred on the tall man, lands 25.1

events.label: onto bush
events._why: annotated: land on the FIRST bush, to the RIGHT of its end sign. The old 26.19 landing touched down on AIR: bush 1's foliage corner only reaches the ball's disk at ~26.22 (rendered frames 26.17-26.20 show the touch right of the corner). Landing at 26.23 puts the touchdown frame ON the foliage - the exact frame the user sees before the 26.26->26.53 decoder skip - and the sign-hop leaves at 26.24, a one-frame touch (chain is the annotated intent; the sink span below puts it IN the foliage)

events.label: sign, on bush
events._why: annotated: hop OVER the first sign from bush 1 and land LEFT of it on bush 2. IMPORTANT: Unity's VideoPlayer clock deterministically SKIPS 26.26 -> 26.53 on this file (measured in-engine, reproducible with a 3s linear run-up), so a cue inside that dead zone fires 0.25s late and desyncs. 26.24 fires on the last live frame before the skip; the arc integrates on video time so the skip carries it through its middle. The story must be told at the frames the player SEES: bottom above the sign top at 26.53 (first post-skip frame), and decisive daylight (>=0.05) through the whole 26.33-26.53 crossing - a 0.024 graze read as overlap (user report). The -0.09 seat adjust (option E) raised the takeoff line further, so h=0.38 keeps that margin while the (sidewalk-sized, sizeDepth) ball's top stays on the frame at the apex. Lands 26.70, past the seat adjust's ramp-out, on bush 2's accepted line

events.label: sign, on bush
events._why: fully above the sign top through its 27.65-27.85 crossing, landing 28.1 midway between this sign and the next

events.label: sign, on bush
events._why: fully above the sign through 28.42-28.62, landing 28.85 on the hedge before its end

events.label: off the hedge
events._why: a deliberate leap off the hedge onto the lot, replacing the eased slide - annotated as more believable

events.label: car
events._why: the descent at 0.95s air still touched the car's pixels at 31.83 (SAM-confirmed); landing 32.08 is right in front of it and clear

events.label: two cars
events._why: the near black car's roof is over the old 34.0 takeoff; starting 0.15s earlier clears it, landing 35.47 annotated exact

events.label: pole
events._why: annotated: same dodge as the 32.7 pole; the pole crosses the column at 37.2-37.5

events.label: chain
events._why: the mid-lot bollard chain: takeoff as the chain reaches the ball (reads as jumping it at ~44.88, the annotated moment), one gravity-exact bound (2.44*sqrt(0.25)=1.22 >= 1.2) over both chain spans, landing 45.9 clear of the second bollard - a 0.9s arc touched down at 45.6 right as that bollard's chain anchor reached the ball's edge, and landing shorter drops into the chain's droop. The chain is undetected (too thin), so the rendered frames are the evidence.

events.label: chain
events._why: the bollard-and-chain fence the ball runs INTO at 46.65 (user-circled frame): its near post crosses the ball's column 46.47-46.76 with its head at y 0.565 against a 0.552 ride line - a 0.013 sliver that read as the ball skimming the post. The old 47.05 hop popped 0.3s AFTER that post had gone by, over empty asphalt. Takeoff 46.42 is airborne (0.043 daylight) before the post touches the disk, crests 46.89 just past it, and the 0.95s bound (gravity-exact: 2.44*sqrt(0.15) = 0.945) carries the landing to 47.37 - past the chain trailing off that post to the left, which sweeps the column 46.8-47.35. One arc covers post and chain, so the front-chain hop is absorbed rather than needing a second beat

events.label: stop sign
events._why: the DO NOT ENTER sign crosses at ~57.3-57.6; annotated 57.32, and an unhurried step reads better than the default quick one

sizeDepth._why: the bushes stand at the sidewalk's NEAR edge (base ~0.95), but the ball rides their TOP edge (~0.60-0.66) and the depth-from-screen-height rule shrank it ~25% across the 25.75 hop as if it had run away from the camera (user report). Size reads this ground-plane line across the whole bush section instead; edges sit mid-arc (26.0 inside the bush hop's flight, 29.5 inside the 29.2 off-the-hedge flight, which lands on the lot at 29.8 where the ride line ~0.83 takes over) so both 0.3s ramps are invisible

pathAdjust._why: ride the middle of the sidewalk with the whole ball against concrete - at +0.05 its upper half sat against the grasses and read as rolling in the greenery. Ends 23.6 (not 23.4): the 0.4s ramp-out was fading this exact correction across 23.0-23.4, right at the 23.2 people takeoff, climbing the ball back onto the grass; at 23.6 the ball is airborne and the fade is invisible

hold the sidewalk axis all the way to the people: the measured line drifts up 0.05 across 22.2-23.2 (toward the corner grass bed) and at 22.7 the ball read as rolling in the greenery again. Stacked on the span above this keeps the line at ~0.92-0.95 - the same height it rides at 21.0-21.9 and the plane the people stand on - so the approach is one level axis

the ball lands at 25.1 on the SAME axis it approached on - the 0.92 sidewalk plane the people stand on - so its distance from the camera is unchanged across the jump. The old +0.05 span started at the touchdown itself (only half ramped-in at 25.1, landing the ball at 0.80, visibly farther than the people) and expired at 25.8, before the 25.75 bush takeoff it should carry. This one is full from 24.95 (mid-flight, invisible) through the landing, the roll, and the bush takeoff, and fades out during the bush arc (airborne, invisible)

ride the bush-1 touch HIGH above the top edge (user chose option E from rendered candidates, 2026-08-23: bottom ~0.58 at 26.23, a clear sliver of daylight over the silhouette - 'on the contour' and every sunk variant still read as in-front-of-the-bush to them). The raw line at the touch is 0.667: the sidewalk->hedge surface step has not converged there, and the corner contour is ~0.615. Full over the grounded touch 26.18-26.28; ramp-out ends at the 26.70 sign-hop landing so bush 2's roll keeps its accepted line
land a touch forward, beside the parked van on the lot; jumping 'too far back' read unnatural
grass bank at the clip end: keep the ball inside the visible region

behindSpans._why: the ball passes behind the pole during this arc
rolling mid-scene: visibly behind the poles it passes

_occluderLabels_why: Cars whose base sits clearly below the ball's line are between the ball
and the camera - the parked grey car at 7.6-8.5s and the van's tall tail
at 11.0-11.3s. The ball descending past them belongs BEHIND them, and the
depth rule already knows which those are; cars at the ball's own depth
(the 31s and 34s landings) fail the margin and stay unoccluded.

frontSpans._why: the slide off the hedge happens in front of the bush and its signs - nothing may occlude it
the ball just goes ABOVE the grey car; the derived occluder made the landing flicker behind-then-in-front of it
